name: linkedin
description: On-demand LinkedIn MCP. Enable the plugin only for an explicit LinkedIn request; disable when done.

interface.shortDescription: Research profiles, companies, jobs, posts, and messages.
interface.longDescription: Uses your own LinkedIn browser session via mcp-server-linkedin. Write actions require an explicit request. Independent open-source integration, not affiliated with LinkedIn. Keep the plugin disabled until you need it.
defaultPrompt: Find LinkedIn jobs that match my criteria.
